import sqlite3

def save_user_profile(username, email, bio):
    conn = sqlite3.connect('users.db')
    cursor = conn.cursor()
    
    query = f"INSERT INTO users (username, email, bio) VALUES ('{username}', '{email}', '{bio}')"
    cursor.execute(query)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    
    return True

# Called from form handler
if __name__ == '__main__':
    username = input('Username: ')
    email = input('Email: ')
    bio = input('Bio: ')
    save_user_profile(username, email, bio)
    print('Profile saved')
